blocks.text: Exercises: more of the lesson's own dialogue lines, with their recordings. FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain).

options: No, no! Straight and then right.
Excuse me, please. How do I get to the hotel “Metropol”?
exercises.why: «Вы сейчас выходите?» — Are you getting off now? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 3.
exercises.context: Диалог 3 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

options: Excuse me, what’s the next station?
You need to get off at the next station and go back.
exercises.why: ««Кропоткинская».» — “Kropotkinskaya”. FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 3.
exercises.context: Диалог 3 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

options: The transfer to the Ring Line is to the right.
exercises.why: «Тогда разрешите пройти.» — Then let me through. FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 3.
exercises.context: Диалог 3 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

options: Could you pass my ticket over there, please?
Excuse me, what’s the next station?
exercises.why: «Спасибо.» — Thanks. FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 3.
exercises.context: Диалог 3 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

exercises.ru: Скажите, пожалуйста, это переход на «Кольцевую линию»?
options: Excuse me, is this the transfer to the Ring Line?
Could you pass my ticket over there, please?
exercises.why: «Скажите, пожалуйста, это переход на «Кольцевую линию»?» — Excuse me, is this the transfer to the Ring Line? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 4.
exercises.context: Диалог 4 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

options: Do you want to take the metro?
exercises.why: «А где здесь переход?» — Then where’s the transfer? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 4.
exercises.context: Диалог 4 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

exercises.ru: Простите, как дойти до американского посольства?
options: The transfer to the Ring Line is to the right.
Excuse me, please. How do I get to the hotel “Metropol”?
No, no! Straight and then right.
Excuse me, how do I get to the American Embassy?
exercises.why: «Простите, как дойти до американского посольства?» — Excuse me, how do I get to the American Embassy? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 5.
exercises.context: Диалог 5 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)

options: Are you getting off at the next stop?
exercises.why: «В какую сторону?» — In which direction? FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain), Диалог 5.
exercises.context: Диалог 5 — FSI Russian FAST Course, Lesson 9 (public domain)
